sourceChecks.sourceText: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
sourceChecks.previousContext: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
sourceChecks.nextContext: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

sourceChecks.sourceText: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
sourceChecks.previousContext: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
sourceChecks.nextContext: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

wikipediaSearch.resultJa: Kishi (biblical figure) の実記事本文を確認。KishiをKushaiahとも記し、1 Chronicles 6:44とMerariの系譜を明記。固定WEB 1CH15:17は同じEthanの父をKushaiahと綴るが、当稿は同一性を断定せず関連記事として扱う。

authorRepairs.noteJa: キシ記事の実本文で対象節/表記を確認。WEBのKishiとKushaiah表記差は関係資料として提示し、個体同一性は断定しない。

authorRepairs.reasonJa: Wikipedia記事はKishiをKushaiahとも記すため、WEB 1CH 15:17でKushaiah表記が現れるまで記事名・注記を表示しないようgateを遅らせた。初出6:44ではエタンの父祖関係だけを示し、同一性は断定しない。
